texts: When wraith activity at the Sunken Cove increases, the neighboring stations request feather rations from the Council.
Whenever wraith sightings at the Sunken Cove rise, the stations ask the Council for feather rations.
The Council weighs the requests against the central feather store.
The Council prioritizes stations with drained lanterns.

fields.sentence: When wraith activity at the Sunken Cove increases, the neighboring stations request feather rations from the Council.
parse: (: wraith_rule (Implication (And (Member $e1 increase) (Theme $e1 sk_activity_1)) (And (Member (sk_request $e1) request) (Agent (sk_request $e1) sk_stations_1) (Theme (sk_request $e1) feather_ration) (Source (sk_request $e1) sk_council_1) (During (sk_request $e1) $e1))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: "neighboring" restrictively describes which stations rather than classifying them into a recognized subtype, so fusing it into the group's kind slot as neighboring_station is not licensed by the adjective+noun fusion test (a descriptive modifier on a plural distributes over the members instead).

Even granting the fusion, exposing the modifier genus (Inheritance neighboring_station neighboring) puts a relational adjective that fails the predication test into a genus atom, which the "assistant secretary" rule bars.

The bare mass NP "wraith activity" is reified as a top-level witness (statement 1) whose "at the Sunken Cove" restrictor is then asserted as a standing LocatedIn fact, so the parse states that wraith activity exists at the Cove although the sentence only conditions on its increasing.

q2_gaps: a distributive predicate over a definite plural group sitting inside a whenever-rule consequent - the doctrine wants the group event plus a per-member (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) ...) distribution rule, and nothing states where that inner rule can go inside another rule's conclusion
review.notes: "the Council" is correctly a plain common-noun witness with no Name atom and "the Sunken Cove" correctly gets Name plus the kind atom from inside the name; Theme for the scalar-change subject of "increases", Source for the "from"-phrase, and the feather_ration genus with its noun modifier unexposed are all licensed.

issues.reason: Adjective+noun fusion is licensed only when the pair 'names a recognized kind' (term of art, origin, role title, material adjective) and 'never for incidental description'; 'neighboring station' is a context-relative description of which stations, not a subtype, so on a plural the modifier must distribute over the members and the invented kind neighboring_station (with its Inheritance atoms) asserts a classification the text does not state.

Conditional on fusion, 'neighboring' is a participial positional adjective predicable of the stations at least as readily as 'east' of 'wing', which the instruction set counts as passing the test, so exposure would be the determined choice — the 'assistant secretary' bar is for rank adjectives that cannot be predicated at all.

A bare (non-definite) trigger participant takes the whenever route's plain-variable premise ('when a bearing seizes') with its restriction as a premise conjunct (the 'stray dogs' pattern), so the top-level (Member sk_activity_1 wraith_activity) and (LocatedIn sk_activity_1 sunken_cove) assert a standing existence and location of wraith activity at the Cove that the sentence only conditions on — 'Assert only what the text states'.

gaps_confirmed: a distributive predicate over a definite plural group inside a whenever-rule consequent: doctrine wants the group event plus a per-member (PartOf $x <group>) rule, and nothing states where that inner rule goes inside another rule's conclusion
new_gaps: a locative restrictor on a bare eventuality-denoting mass noun ('wraith activity at the Cove'): whether it takes the thing-head LocatedIn or the eventuality-head Location is undecided, and its placement as a premise conjunct is only inferable from the 'stray dogs' restriction-as-premise pattern
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: (GroupOf sk_stations_1 station) plus (Implication (PartOf $x sk_stations_1) (Member $x neighboring)) (STV 1.0 0.9), with no neighboring_station symbol or decomposition atoms. Issue 2: the trigger participant as a plain variable in the premise — (And (Member $a wraith_activity) (LocatedIn $a sunken_cove) (Member $e1 increase) (Theme $e1 $a)) — with sunken_cove typed and named at top level and the definitional (Inheritance wraith_activity activity) kept, asserting no activity witness (LocatedIn versus Location on the restrictor is itself a gap).
adjudication.notes: Theme for the scalar-change subject, Source for 'from the Council', the un-Named capitalized collective 'the Council', the bare-kind Theme feather_ration with its genus, and the During-linked Skolem request event are to spec.

fields.sentence: Whenever wraith sightings at the Sunken Cove rise, the stations ask the Council for feather rations.
parse: (: sighting_rise_ask_rule (Implication (And (Member $e rise) (Theme $e wraith_sighting) (Location $e sunken_cove)) (And (Member (sk_ask $e) ask) (Agent (sk_ask $e) sk_station_1) (Recipient (sk_ask $e) sk_council_1) (For (sk_ask $e) feather_ration) (During (sk_ask $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: "at the Sunken Cove" sits inside the subject NP and restricts "wraith sightings", but the parse attaches it to the matrix event as (Location $e sunken_cove) — that asserts a location of the rising the sentence never states and leaves the sightings themselves unrestricted.

q2_gaps: a restrictive locative PP on a bare-plural NP rendered as a bare kind symbol — no licensed carrier exists (a kind may not fill LocatedIn's entity slot, and ConditionalProperty covers only kind-level property claims, not a rule premise's role filler)

a definite plural with a distributive predicate ("the stations ask") inside a whenever-rule conclusion — the per-member (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) ...) distribution rule a standalone clause would emit has nowhere to go inside a conclusion
review.notes: "the Sunken Cove" (one opaque name symbol plus the kind atom read off the name) and "the Council" (capitalized common noun, no Name) both follow Names and casing, and (For ...) for the requested rations is the licensed preposition-named oblique. Theme on the rise subject is correct per the scalar-change routing.

issues.reason: The syntactic half stands — pre-verbal 'at the Sunken Cove' restricts the sightings, not the rising — but the defect half does not: the instruction set licenses no carrier for a restrictive PP on a bare-kind Theme filler (the reviewer's own gap), Core patterns forbids dropping the restriction, and inside a rule premise the event-attached `(Location $e sunken_cove)` picks out the same triggers (a rise in sightings at the cove is a rise at the cove), so it is acceptable gap improvisation rather than a false or over-asserted atom.

gaps_confirmed: A restrictive locative PP on a bare-plural NP rendered as a bare kind symbol: no licensed carrier (a kind may not fill LocatedIn's entity slot; ConditionalProperty covers only kind-level property claims, not a premise role filler).

A definite plural with a distributive predicate ('the stations ask') inside a whenever-rule conclusion: the per-member `(Implication (PartOf $x <group>) …)` distribution rule has no stated place inside a conclusion, so group-as-unit is the only available form.
new_gaps: A bare-plural scalar-change subject in a rule premise ('wraith sightings … rise'): the scalar-change examples take a definite dimension-noun witness as Theme; whether a bare kind may fill Theme in a premise or must be a variable group is unstated, which also decides whether a later episodic 'sightings rose' (a group witness) would ever match this premise.
adjudication.notes: Name plus kind-from-the-name for 'the Sunken Cove', common-noun 'the Council', the definite-plural group for 'the stations', Recipient for the addressee and the `For` oblique for the requested rations, Theme on the scalar-change subject and both compound genus atoms all follow the instruction set.

fields.sentence: The Council weighs the requests against the central feather store.

review.notes: "The Council" correctly takes the singular-collective capitalized-common-noun default (no Name atom, no GroupOf, no member distribution), the definite plural object takes a group witness, and "weigh X against Y" puts the prepositional object in the surface-preposition oblique while the evaluated object stays Theme. feather_store fuses with its genus and its noun modifier unexposed, central stays a separate Member property on the witness, and the simple present correctly carries no status atom.

fields.sentence: The Council prioritizes stations with drained lanterns.
parse: (: council_prioritize_rule (Implication (And (Member $station station) (Member $lantern lantern) (PartOf $lantern $station) (Member $lantern drained)) (And (Member (sk_prioritize $station) prioritize) (Agent (sk_prioritize $station) sk_council_1) (Theme (sk_prioritize $station) $station))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The rule carries strength 1.0, the explicit-universal value, although "stations" is a bare plural with no quantifier word (and no QuantifierPhrase companion is emitted), so the bare-generic strength 0.9 is what the dial prescribes.
"stations with drained lanterns" is encoded as (PartOf $lantern $station), asserting a part/component relation that the surface "with" states only as association.

q2_gaps: attributive "with"-PP modifying a noun ("stations with drained lanterns") — no head is legislated for an associative/possessive "with" on an entity; the PartOf-vs-Possession test is defined only for 's / possessive-pronoun / of-phrase genitives, and the "with"-split rule is event-side (CoAgent vs Instrument)

a restrictively modified bare-plural object under a habitual clause whose subject is a specific individual — the bare-kind filler prescribed for non-specific objects has no slot for the restriction, and the rule machinery is keyed on a subject kind or an explicit universal, not on the object
review.notes: The witness-subject-plus-rule-over-the-object shape mirrors the licensed exists-forall pattern, and "the Council" is correctly one collective individual with no Name atom and no distribution. The open points are the rule strength and the head chosen for the "with"-PP.

issues.reason: Rule strength is the quantity — 'all 1.0, generic/most 0.9' — and 'stations with drained lanterns' is a bare plural with no quantifier word (correctly no QuantifierPhrase), so strength 1.0 asserts the Council prioritizes every such station where the text states a generic.

The surface 'with' states that a station has a lantern, not that the lantern is a component of it, and the instruction set says 'never invent membership or PartOf the words don't state' — the non-over-committing carriers are the opaque loose-association Possession or the entity-attached surface With.

gaps_confirmed: attributive 'with'-PP on a noun ('stations with drained lanterns'): no head is legislated for an entity-attached associative 'with' — the PartOf/Possession test covers 's, possessive pronouns and of-phrases, and the with-split (CoAgent/Instrument) is event-side

a restrictively modified bare-plural object under an individual-subject habitual: the bare kind filler has no slot for the restriction, and the rule machinery is keyed on a subject kind or an explicit universal, not on the object
new_gaps: a premise variable that only restricts another ($lantern restricting $station): 'a Skolem function of every universal that scopes over it' read strictly would key the prioritize event on the lantern too, yielding one event per lantern rather than per station — the instruction set does not say whether restrictor variables count
adjudication.defect_summary: Set the rule to (STV 0.9 0.9) for the bare-plural generic range; and replace (PartOf $lantern $station) with (Possession $lantern $station) (the loose-association licence) or the entity-attached surface (With $station $lantern) — no single form is legislated for attributive 'with', which stands as the confirmed gap.
adjudication.notes: The Council as one singular-collective individual with no Name and no distribution, Theme for the evaluated stations, the participial modifier as the adjective drained, and the exists-forall shape (constant subject, rule over the object) all follow the instruction set.
